python3 - << 'PY'
import statistics

# Total reserve assets from IFS-1 (in millions of dollars)
# Source: 1987 bulletin (page 69) for 1983-1986, 1992 bulletin (page 84) for 1987-1990
data = {
    1983: 33747,
    1984: 34934,
    1985: 43186,
    1986: 48511,  # marked 'r' (revised) in 1987 bulletin
    1987: 45798,  # from 1992 bulletin
    1988: 47802,
    1989: 74809,
    1990: 83318,
}

# Extract values in order
values = [data[year] for year in range(1983, 1991)]
print("Years:", list(range(1983, 1991)))
print("Values (millions):", values)

# Compute sample standard deviation (stdev uses n-1 denominator)
sample_stdev = statistics.stdev(values)
print(f"\nSample standard deviation (n-1): {sample_stdev}")

# Compute population standard deviation (pstdev uses n denominator)
pop_stdev = statistics.pstdev(values)
print(f"Population standard deviation (n): {pop_stdev}")

# The question asks for standard deviation - typically this means sample stdev
# Rounded to 4 decimal places
result = round(sample_stdev, 4)
print(f"\nResult (sample stdev, 4 decimals): {result}")
PY

import math

values = [33747, 34934, 43186, 48511, 45798, 47802, 74809, 83318]

# Manual calculation of sample standard deviation
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Sum of squared deviations
sum_sq_dev = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in values)
print(f"Sum of squared deviations: {sum_sq_dev}")

# Sample variance (n-1 denominator)
sample_variance = sum_sq_dev / (n - 1)
print(f"Sample variance: {sample_variance}")

# Sample standard deviation
sample_stdev = math.sqrt(sample_variance)
print(f"Sample stdev: {sample_stdev}")
print(f"Rounded to 4 decimals: {round(sample_stdev, 4)}")
PY
